A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual served as a '''Jedi Master''' of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who was eventually known as [[Darth Bandon]]. Bandon's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] tried to curb the brash young man's anger and hatred, but Bandon chafed under his master's guidance.<ref name="databank" /> Shortly after the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]], declared war on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]<ref name="Insider 88">{{InsiderCite|88|Heritage of the Sith}}</ref> and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="KotOR SG: Darth Bandon" /> in [[3959 BBY]],<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Bandon betrayed his Master and [[Desertion/Legends|defected]] to Revan's [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]<ref name="KotOR SG: Darth Bandon" /> during the ensuing [[Jedi Civil War]]. Bandon went on to became a student at the revitalized [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and eventually [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malak's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and [[Shadow Hand]].<ref name="KotOR CG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Master was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]] for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''<ref name="KotOR SG: Darth Bandon" /> both of which were released in [[July]] [[2003]].<ref name="Kotor Release">{{SW|url=news/kotor-galaxy-of-heroes|text=BioWare and Capital Games on Bringing ''KotOR'' Fan Favorites into ''Galaxy of Heroes''|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="Kotor Guide Date">{{CargoBay|url=item-detail/12540|text=Knights of the Old Republic}}</ref>
